Conclusion: not the SEQ_LEN bug -- looks like the known DDPG/TD3 pathology of collapsing to a safe "never take the rare high-variance action" local optimum, since the actor is updated via dQ/da at observed states and the critic likely undercovers the harvest dimension (1-in-600-step action). 25pct demo-buffer transition mixing was not enough to prevent this -- it only biases which TRANSITIONS get sampled, not the actor loss itself. Next: TD3+BC (Fujimoto and Gu 2021) -- explicit BC regularization term added directly to the actor loss, not just replay-buffer mixing.
